basic_details.job_title: RGSSH Assistant Nursing Superintendent Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Posts

content_sections.heading: RGSSH Assistant Nursing Superintendent at a Glance
Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must satisfy the following qualification, experience, and registration criteria to apply for the post: Essential Qualification: B.Sc (Nursing); OR Certificate in General Nursing and Midwifery and 'A' Grade certificate in Nursing from a recognized institution, along with a Post certificate diploma in nursing administration/sister tutor's course. Experience: Five-year experience as nursing sister/Theatre Sister. Registration: Candidates applying for the post of ANS should be registered with Delhi Nursing Council (DNC) or any other nursing council. After selection, registration with DNC mentioning their essential qualification for the selected post is mandatory. Age Limit: Age limit is 55 years. Age relaxations apply to SC/ST/OBC/Departmental Candidates/ExSM/PWh etc. in accordance with the instructions/orders issued by Govt. of India/DoPT/Govt of NCT of Delhi from time to time. Candidates seeking benefits of age relaxation under SC/ST/OBC/PwD categories must produce the relevant certificates issued on or before the last date of application filling, and OBC candidates must provide a non-creamy layer certificate issued within six months prior by the competent authority of Govt. of NCT of Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate receives a consolidated pay scale of Rs. 15,600-39,100 with Grade Pay Rs. 5,400 (Level 10 of the 7th CPC). The appointment is initially for a period of 05 years on a contractual basis, subject to satisfactory work and conduct report from the Director, RGSSH being HOD. Further extension is based on an annual performance appraisal report as per MOA of the hospital. The contract engagement is not pensionable.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGSSH Assistant Nursing Superintendent
content_sections.text: Fill out the Google form available on the hospital website or via the link provided in the notification before the last date of 22.10.2026 (till 12:00 Mid Night). Take a print out of the filled Google form. Bring the printed Google form along with original and photocopy of requisite documents on the date of interview. Candidates currently working in Govt. Hospitals/PSUs/Autonomous Bodies etc. should bring a "No Objection Certificate/prior intimation certificate" and "Experience certificate" from their present employer at the time of interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Mode of selection is based on interview. During the interview process, candidate's educational qualification, experience, additional qualification, award, paper presentation etc. will also be taken into account. The tentative date of interview is 30.10.2026, and the detailed schedule will be shared on the hospital website.

faq.question: Q1. Is the Assistant Nursing Superintendent post permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is initially for a period of 05 years on a contractual basis and is not pensionable. Further extension is based on satisfactory work performance and annual performance appraisal.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible for age relaxation?
faq.answer: Age relaxation is applicable to SC, ST, OBC, Departmental candidates, Ex-Servicemen, and PwD candidates in accordance with Govt. of India/DoPT/Govt of NCT of Delhi rules. OBC candidates must produce a non-creamy layer certificate issued within six months by the competent authority of Govt. of NCT of Delhi.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents are required to be brought for the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a printout of the filled Google form along with original and photocopy of all requisite documents. Working candidates must also bring a No Objection Certificate and experience certificate from their current employer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.
